rv.q: This is a thoughtful play with a spectacular production design.
As a cradle Christian, I was impressed by this performance and its thought-provoking narrative.
This production takes Citadel Theatre to a new level.
Make no mistake about it, my musings aside,this is a good to very good show, well worth seeing, but it was aiming to be a great show and it missed.
Hnath certainly deserves the Obie and Citadel and its excellent actors and crew deserve the standing ovation they received opening night.
I give this play a high recommendation.
So, Citadel should be applauded for introducing it to its audience base.

cn.t: Citadel's production of this Obie-winning theological drama earns praise for its thought-provoking questions about faith and hell, plus striking design. Critics appreciate the provocative debate, though note it offers more questions than answers.
